en-US.name: Clean Connect: India Cleanup
en-US.subtitle: Report Litter & Join Drives
en-US.promotionalText: New in 2.0: report garbage spots across India, join cleanup drives, share before/after photos and support cleaners directly via UPI.

appPrivacy.notes: Precise location is only stored when the user pins a report or a drive meeting point. No analytics, ads or third-party tracking SDKs. Payments are never processed in the app.
